Day 8 of 30: 10 Free Apps Every Creator Needs

Today’s app: Adobe Premiere Rush 🎬

If you want to edit videos quickly without getting overwhelmed by a full editing software, Adobe Rush is a solid app to have.

✅ Edit videos from your phone or computer
✅ Add music, transitions, and text
✅ Great for Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and vlogs
✅ Simple timeline for quick edits
✅ Perfect for creators who need clean content fast

Not every video needs a full Premiere Pro edit. Sometimes you just need to cut, clean it up, add captions or music, and post.

Apps so far:

Day 1: ChatGPT
Day 2: Google Docs
Day 3: Google Drive
Day 4: Canva
Day 5: Captions.ai
Day 6: Opus Clip
Day 7: Riverside
Day 8: Adobe Rush
